messages:
Ivy Chen: Quick proposal— implement a 7-day 'action lease' for P1 followups and a short handoff snippet whenever ownership changes. small measures to reduce stale remediation cards.

Marcus Brown: sounds good. what's in the handoff snippet?

Ivy Chen: Minimal required fields: from, to, date, 3-line remaining work, blockers, success_metric. example below.

Ivy Chen: ```
handoff:
  from: "@old"
  to: "@new"
  date: "2025-09-10T14:00Z"
  remaining: "1) add test, 2) deploy canary, 3) monitor"
  blockers: "db rollback dependency"
  success_metric: "error_rate < 0.05% for 24h"
```

Leila Haddad: +1. Also propose an escalation at 48h with auto-reminder and, if still stale at TTL expiry, escalate to team lead.

Marcus Brown: for comms cadence, keep incident thread updates to a 3-bullet micro-template: what changed / next action / ETA. short helps triage.

incident-bot: Followup created -> FUP-7812 (owner: Ivy Chen). TTL: 7d. Reminder scheduled in 48h.

Ivy Chen: next steps: add the snippet to the runbook (Ivy) - PR in 48h; wire incident-bot TTL & escalation (Marcus) - prototype in 5d; trial on next two P1s (Leila) - start sprint. anyone object?

Leila Haddad: no objections, let's trial it.

Marcus Brown: starting bot work tomorrow. will post prototype link here.

Ivy Chen: thanks all, will open runbook PR now. :rocket:
